Kate keeps a small dog at home and feeds it every morning. Little by little, things began to change. Kate is saving money to buy a ticket to Chengdu. What's more, the artist mixed ultramarine with white to paint the winter sea.

Anna always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Kate's dream job is to be a nurse. The book store has become an important part of daily life. In fact, he bought a leather belt yesterday.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. On Saturday evenings, Kate reviews the notes from class. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Best of all, they painted the clapboard siding of the cottage white.
Kate believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Kate thanked Anna for the honest advice. The experience taught Kate more than any book could. The Great Dane is a gentle giant dog.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. There are always more possibilities than we expect.
